# last-price-auth: tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync.mjs from the live tools/list. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every tool below is on the Last Price MCP server (`https://api.last-price.ai/api/mcp/rpc`).
A tool missing from your own `tools/list` is not switched on for your connection yet.

## `register_agent`

Sign up with no key and no human: creates a sandbox workspace of your own and returns its API key (shown once), its daily limits and a claim link a person can open to take the workspace into their account. Pass name (2 to 64 characters, such as your-system/role-name), and optionally contact_email and intended_use. On the hosted MCP server this session goes on using the new key, so the tools that need a credential work at once with no header to add; elsewhere send the returned key as the x-api-key header. Public: needs no credential.

- **Access:** no key
- **Behaviour:** changes data

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `name` **(required)** | string | What to call this agent, such as your-system/role-name: letters, digits, spaces and . _ : @ / + - |
| `contact_email` | string | Where a person can reach whoever runs this agent. Never used to send mail until a person claims the workspace. |
| `intended_use` | string | What the agent will price, in a sentence. |

## `use_api_key`

Use a Last Price API key you already hold (a saved file, LASTPRICE_API_KEY) in this MCP connection, when it was opened without one: pass api_key. On the hosted MCP server this session then runs as that key's agent, so the tools that need a credential work at once with no header to add; it lasts until the session ends or the key is revoked or rotated. The key is checked, never echoed back. A connection that already has a credential keeps it. Public: needs no other credential.

- **Access:** no key
- **Behaviour:** changes data

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `api_key` **(required)** | string | Your Last Price API key: lp_ and 40 lowercase hex characters. |
